investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All Available Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the remote agent pod because 2 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Because the pod never became schedulable, the agent VM was never provisioned, and the eval runner received no evidence — leaving all four required contract fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) entirely absent.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the production-api remote-agents feature has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource allocation on the two nodes that match the pod's node affinity/selector. With 0/6 nodes available — 2 due to insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm quota and 4 due to affinity/selector mismatch — every remote agent pod submitted during this eval window was stuck Unschedulable for 131–145 seconds before the eval timed out. No preemption victims were available, so the scheduler could not free capacity automatically. The eval never reached the agent creation step, so no evidence was written and the expected-output contract (vmIdPresent=true, remoteState in [running, idle, ready]) could not be satisfied. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity constraint, not a confirmed user-facing outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All Available Nodes
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the remote agent pod because 2 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Because the pod never became schedulable, the agent VM was never provisioned, and the eval runner received no evidence — leaving all four required contract fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) entirely absent.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the production-api remote-agents feature has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource allocation on the two nodes that match the pod's node affinity/selector. With 0/6 nodes available — 2 due to insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm quota and 4 due to affinity/selector mismatch — every remote agent pod submitted during this eval window was stuck Unschedulable for 131–145 seconds before the eval timed out. No preemption victims were available, so the scheduler could not free capacity automatically. The eval never reached the agent creation step, so no evidence was written and the expected-output contract (vmIdPresent=true, remoteState in [running, idle, ready]) could not be satisfied. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity constraint, not a confirmed user-facing outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
